nulls.parent_conditioned: L2/L3 only, each parent keeps its item count and child-count histogram

status.A: EXACT for every eligible node/edge; undefined handled per metric
status.B: EXACT per parent; parents with <2 children/wedges/edges excluded from the corresponding aggregate and counted
status.C: MONTE_CARLO nulls; delta/z/ratio only when the metric is defined; z requires sd>0
status.D: SECONDARY induced subgraph; lost nodes/edges/items recorded

settings.quotient: complete Q_l, one node per occupied prefix (singletons kept), edge iff a TRAIN item edge crosses, unweighted, no self-loops
settings.no_caps: no item, group, node, edge or sampled-group limit

family.description: the complete frozen A/B/C/D exploratory family at every applicable level, primary cohort 108; Holm across the family

verdict.rule: GAIN only if a candidate has a valid geometry definition, coverage >= 0.95, the paired-bootstrap CI for its |rho| gain over its declared baseline excludes 0, and its direction is stable within the 76-arm curvature_RQ-VAE cohort; otherwise NO STABLE GAIN
